description:
Here are the descriptions of the line plots, following your guidelines:

The plots illustrate the relative change in performance for different configurations of a KV cache compression technique. Both plots share a common x-axis labeled "Layer" with a linear scale ranging from Layer13-20 to Layer29, with tick labels at Layer13-20, Layer21-28, and Layer29. The y-axis is labeled "Relative Change" with a linear scale ranging from -15% to 5%, with tick labels at -15%, -5%, 0%, and 5%. 

The first plot displays four lines: a yellow line representing "LB-Avg of 2×tokens,8-bit" with circular markers, a blue line representing "RULER4k of 2×tokens,8-bit" with square markers, a light blue line representing "Baseline of 4×tokens,4-bit" with triangular markers, and a gray dashed line representing "RULER4k of 4×tokens,4-bit". The yellow line starts at approximately 0.5% at Layer13-20, increases to approximately 2.5% at Layer29. The blue line begins at approximately 0% at Layer13-20, increases to approximately 3% at Layer29. The light blue line starts at approximately 1% at Layer13-20, decreases to approximately -14% at Layer21-28, and then increases to approximately -6% at Layer29. The gray dashed line begins at approximately 0% at Layer13-20, increases to approximately 2% at Layer29.
